title: Agent Lifecycle Management
summary: Apply orchestration patterns, configure parallel isolation, detect and resolve conflicts, manage agent lifecycles, and implement recovery in multi-agent workflows.

items: **Add:** Introduce with isolation; validate in staging; ensure state compatibility
**Update:** Drain in-flight tasks first → update → validate in isolation → reintroduce
**Replace:** Treat as add + retire; preserve handoff continuity; migrate state artifacts
**Retire:** Remove from execution; PRESERVE all audit artifacts, decision logs, outputs

blocks.text: **Retirement ≠ Deletion:** Retiring an agent must NOT delete its audit trail. Logs and outputs must be retained for compliance — even after full decommission.
